text: Final categorization: REVIEW (Justification: This is a review article that synthesizes and evaluates existing methods for quantifying Holocene anthropogenic land-cover change (LULC) in temperate China. It compares pollen-based REVEALS reconstructions with archaeological data and the HYDE land-use scenario, focusing on reconstructing past LULC changes to evaluate anthropogenic climate forcing. While it discusses future implications for climate modeling, its primary purpose is to review and synthesize past LULC reconstruction methods and evidence, not to make future LULC predictions itself.)
